description: araara: the OCaml 5 web stack on hcs (Eio, io_uring). HCS router, request/response helpers, Plug.Compress for JSON, Plug.Static for files (pre-compressed .br/.gz twins selected per request), hcs gRPC transport with ocaml-protoc codecs, simdjsont JSON, repodb for Postgres. HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 (TLS and h2c) and WebSocket from one process, one single-domain worker per CPU with SO_REUSEPORT and the runtime's default GC settings.
